clue.text: Sounds like Cook? Sounds like ass!

indicators.note: the first 'Sounds like' asks for a word that is said the same as a cooking verb

parts.note: to braise is to cook slowly in a covered pot

explanation.surface: A jibe that some cook makes noises like a donkey.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'Sounds like' is the trick: the first signals a word said aloud, the second is part of the definition, the noises a donkey makes.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey's harsh cries are called brays, so these are the noises an ass makes.

clue.text: Kitchen block where one may cut into tin

definitions.text: Kitchen block where one may cut into tin

parts.words: Kitchen block where one may cut into tin
parts.note: a kitchen surface on which a tin loaf is sliced, with tin wanting to be metal

explanation.surface: Where in a kitchen you might slice open a metal can.
explanation.walkthrough: A tin here is a tin loaf, baked in a tin, not a can of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden board used for slicing loaves in the kitchen, where a tin loaf would be cut.

clue.text: A social occasion — stew is provided

parts.note: a do is a party or social occasion

explanation.surface: A party where stew is served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stew' is a state of agitation, not food.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a stew means being in a fuss, and a fuss is commotion.

clue.text: Underfed in pub —— get blue about that

indicators.note: about means the blue word goes round the pub word

parts.note: sky blue, the colour of the sky
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A hungry drinker in a bar grows gloomy about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' is the colour of the sky, not gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone underfed is thin, and skinny means very thin.

clue.text: Evil creature walkin' painfully without energy

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the walking word goes around the energy word

parts.note: hobbling is walking painfully, with the dropped g mirrored in the clue
go means energy or vigour

explanation.surface: A nasty creature limping along without any pep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but here has its old meaning, 'outside', so the walking word wraps round the energy word.
explanation.definitionFit: A goblin of folklore is a mischievous or malevolent sprite, an evil little creature.

clue.text: Give Arab ruler audible greeting

parts.note: to hand is to give

indicators.note: audible means the ruler's title is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: a sheikh is an Arab ruler

explanation.surface: Offering an Arab leader a spoken hello.
explanation.definitionFit: Clasping hands is a common gesture of greeting.

clue.text: US city has no more Indian food

indicators.note: has no means the word more is taken away

parts.note: Baltimore is a city in Maryland
taken as written

explanation.surface: An American city has run out of curry.
explanation.definitionFit: A balti is a spiced curry dish cooked and served in a metal pan.

clue.text: In hospital, Gershwin and Co picked up musical instruments

indicators.note: in a down clue picked up means the run is read upwards

parts.note: san, short for sanatorium, is a hospital
Ira Gershwin, the lyricist brother of George
CO is short for company

explanation.surface: The Gershwins, in hospital, take up instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' reverses SANIRACO, so each piece reads backwards: NAS, ARI, OC from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument, a type of musical instrument.

clue.text: Contemporary saint, one dedicated missionary

parts.note: living means existing now, contemporary
taken as written

explanation.surface: A modern holy figure, a devoted missionary.
explanation.definitionFit: David Livingstone was a dedicated Scottish missionary and explorer in Africa.

clue.text: Greek character will appear useless

parts.note: nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet
'll is the contracted form of will

explanation.surface: A Greek figure is going to prove useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Null as in null and void means invalid, without force, so useless.

clue.text: Loving gesture accepted by English gangster

indicators.note: something accepted by others is taken in, so the gesture word sits inside the other two

parts.note: Al Capone, the Chicago gangster, gives AL
a motion is a movement of the hand, a gesture

explanation.surface: An English mobster receives an affectionate gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: Loving and emotional both describe feelings openly shown, a close synonym pair.

clue.text: Bone buried in Northumbrian village

indicators.note: something buried in the words lies concealed within them, read across the word break

explanation.surface: A skeleton dug up in a village in the north of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Northumbria is the far north-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The anvil, or incus, is one of the three tiny bones of the middle ear.

clue.text: Twisting into disc again, he may identify your problem

indicators.note: twisting the letters wrenches them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who works out what is wrong with you by spinning back into a disc.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagnostician is a doctor or expert whose job is identifying an illness or fault.

clue.text: Ever-fresh anthem, an air that's moving

indicators.note: moving letters are shifted about into a fresh order

explanation.surface: An evergreen anthem, with a tune that stirs the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Amaranth was a mythical flower that never fades, so amaranthine means everlasting, never withering.

clue.text: Unchallengeable co-stars can cut up rough

indicators.note: to cut up rough is to behave violently, so these letters are knocked about

explanation.surface: Untouchable fellow actors can turn nasty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sacrosanct is too sacred to be questioned or violated.

clue.text: Where you'll find pavilion with old backward-facing toilet

indicators.note: facing backwards means the toilet word is read from right to left

parts.note: lav is short for lavatory, a toilet

explanation.surface: A sports ground where the pavilion has an old toilet facing the wrong way.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London cricket ground, with a pavilion for the players.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oval is a famous cricket ground, and a pavilion is the clubhouse at such a ground.

clue.text: Asian space, very fluid

indicators.note: letters that are very fluid flow freely into a new order

explanation.surface: A vast Asian expanse that is entirely liquid.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a great body of water in Asia, a 'space' that is very fluid indeed.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's largest inland body of water lies between Europe and Asia, an Asian expanse of liquid.

clue.text: Pressure to withdraw, having not denied love for model

parts.note: to recede is to withdraw

indicators.note: denied means the love letter is refused, taken out of the word not

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: Under pressure to back out, refusing to deny love for a model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'denied' takes O out of NOT, leaving NT.
explanation.definitionFit: A precedent is an earlier example used as a model for later cases.

clue.text: Provided with restorative treatment and a service, having got old

parts.note: a Mass is a church service
aged means grown old

explanation.surface: Someone given a rubdown and a church service, having grown old.
explanation.definitionFit: Being massaged means being given a therapeutic rubbing, a restorative treatment.

clue.text: Extraordinarily keen and aware daughter stirred up afresh

indicators.note: used extraordinarily, the letters are set in an unusual new order

explanation.surface: A keen and alert daughter has been roused once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extraordinarily' rearranges KEEN and AWARE into REAWAKENE; D finishes it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be roused again is to be woken or stirred up a second time.

clue.text: Shoddy work returned — nothing right

indicators.note: returned means the work word comes back the other way

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Second-rate work sent back with nothing done properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Shoddy and inferior work is poor in quality, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Shopper may have this question probing risk

indicators.note: probing means the question word pokes inside the risk word

parts.note: a bet is a risk
to ask is to question

explanation.surface: A shopper may pose a question on taking risks.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopper carries purchases in a basket, the woven or wire container.

clue.text: Make exploratory approach before committing oneself to Cheltenham?

definitions.text: Make exploratory approach before committing oneself to Cheltenham?

parts.words: Make exploratory approach before committing oneself to Cheltenham?
parts.note: an idiom for trying things out cautiously, and a literal reading of sampling the mineral springs of a spa town

explanation.surface: Testing the ground before signing up for a move to a Gloucestershire town.
explanation.walkthrough: Cheltenham is an English spa town famed for its healing springs, so a visitor there might literally sample its water.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to try something out cautiously before fully committing; Cheltenham's spa springs make it literal.

clue.text: A lie about British food

indicators.note: about means the lie word goes round the British letter

parts.note: a tale is a lie or fib

explanation.surface: A false story about British cuisine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'food' is the food provided, as in 'she keeps a good table'.
explanation.definitionFit: Table can mean the food served at a meal, as in keeping a fine table.

clue.text: Society that's all but closed and no good?

parts.note: a door that is to is pushed almost shut

explanation.surface: A club that nearly shuts its doors and is worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: The grid's PONG cannot come from this wordplay: TO plus NG gives TONG.
explanation.definitionFit: A tong is a Chinese secret society or association, often linked to crime.

clue.text: Outstanding side getting nothing initially

indicators.note: initially says the nothing letter comes first, at the start

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a wing is a side, as of a building or army

explanation.surface: An exceptional team that has failed to score from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' means unpaid, still due, not excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt that is outstanding is still unpaid, still due to someone.

clue.text: Nervous disorder? Stop working

definitions.meaning: a collapse of mental health, a crack-up
as a verb phrase, a machine conking out or failing

explanation.definitionFit: Both a mental collapse and a mechanical failure share the name; as a phrasal verb it means ceasing to function.

clue.text: Monster bird not quite managing to get up

indicators.note: in a down clue getting up means the letters read upwards
not quite means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a crow is a bird
the final letter dropped

explanation.surface: A creature of a bird that cannot quite take off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite' drops W from CROW to make CRO, and 'managing to get up' turns it to ORC.
explanation.definitionFit: An orc is a goblin-like monster of folklore and fantasy fiction.

clue.text: In welcome fails to appear most eager

indicators.note: in says the fails word is placed inside the welcome word

parts.note: to greet is to welcome
an engine dies when it fails

explanation.surface: At a reception, the keenest guest does not show up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fails' is a verb here, as an engine dies; 'to appear' is only a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The greediest person is the one most eager or avid for something, a superlative synonym.

clue.text: Diplomacy with English being kept quiet!

indicators.note: being kept means the English letter is held inside the diplomacy word

parts.note: tact is diplomacy, skill in handling people

explanation.surface: Tactful handling of the English means saying nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: TACET is the musical direction telling a player to be silent.
explanation.definitionFit: In a musical score this Latin word instructs a player to remain silent, an order to be quiet.
